requirements.quote:
When multiple extensions of different types are present, the
   extensions MAY appear in any order
requirements.condition: an extension block contains multiple different extension types other than the ClientHello pre_shared_key exception
requirements.required_behavior: permit those extensions in any order
requirements.forbidden_behavior: impose another generic extension ordering requirement
requirements.why_checkable: Parsers can be exercised with permutations of distinct extension types.

requirements.quote:
"pre_shared_key" (Section 4.2.11) which MUST be the last extension in
   the ClientHello
requirements.condition: ClientHello contains pre_shared_key
requirements.required_behavior: encode pre_shared_key as the final extension
requirements.forbidden_behavior: place any extension after pre_shared_key
requirements.why_checkable: The ClientHello extension sequence can be checked for the pre_shared_key index.

requirements.quote:
but can appear anywhere in the ServerHello
   extensions block
requirements.condition: ServerHello contains pre_shared_key
requirements.required_behavior: permit pre_shared_key at any position in the ServerHello extension block
requirements.forbidden_behavior: apply the ClientHello final-position rule to ServerHello
requirements.why_checkable: ServerHello parsers can be tested with pre_shared_key at each legal position.

requirements.quote:
There MUST NOT be more than one extension of the
   same type in a given extension block.
requirements.condition: encoding or validating an extension block
requirements.required_behavior: allow at most one extension of each type
requirements.forbidden_behavior: send or accept duplicate extension types in one block
requirements.why_checkable: Duplicate types can be generated and the encoder or parser's uniqueness check observed.

requirements.quote:
In TLS 1.3, unlike TLS 1.2, extensions are negotiated for each
   handshake even when in resumption-PSK mode.
requirements.condition: performing any TLS 1.3 handshake, including resumption with a PSK
requirements.required_behavior: negotiate extensions for the current handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: skip extension negotiation solely because the connection uses resumption PSK
requirements.why_checkable: A resumed handshake can be inspected for a fresh extension negotiation exchange.

requirements.quote:
However, 0-RTT
   parameters are those negotiated in the previous handshake
requirements.condition: the implementation sends, accepts, or validates 0-RTT data
requirements.required_behavior: use the 0-RTT parameters negotiated in the previous handshake
requirements.forbidden_behavior: bind 0-RTT processing solely to newly negotiated current-handshake parameters
requirements.why_checkable: Stored resumption state and 0-RTT parameter selection can be compared with the preceding handshake.
